profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, that trades under the ticker COUR. Its site describes it as a place to learn job-ready skills through online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees offered with partners including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. It also offers Coursera Plus, described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The company's own material places AI among its main subject areas, alongside data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering. It points learners to programs such as the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, and the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, and says many learners begin with beginner-friendly Python or generative AI courses. It also describes job-aligned certificates and specializations built with employers and universities, including the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization.

Company records list Coursera as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001651562. Its litigation record shows 281 cases in California.
